title: ENCL: Enabling Efficient Neuromorphic Continual Learning with Local Learning Rule and Sub-Network Freezing Strategy
abstract: arXiv:2610.31927v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continual learning (CL) in neural networks is a promising learning approach for updating the knowledge of deployed systems based on new data encountered at run time, that have not been learned during the offline training phase. To enable their power/energy-efficient CL processing, neuromorphic continual learning (NCL) concept with sparse event-based operations have recently been introduced. However, state-of-the-art NCL methods typically employ the memory-hungry data/experience replay, coupled with costly global learning rule (i.e., backpropagation-based surrogate gradient). To address these limitations, we propose ENCL, a novel methodology that enables efficient NCL by employing a lightweight local learning rule and sub-network freezing strategy. ENCL leverages the temporally- and spatially-local learning rule to perform efficient credit assignment for training new tasks, alleviating the expensive cost of global learning rule. ENCL al

translated_title: ENCL：通过局部学习规则与子网络冻结策略实现高效神经形态持续学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.31927v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：神经网络中的持续学习（CL）是一种很有前景的学习方法，用于在运行时根据离线训练阶段未曾学习过的新数据来更新已部署系统的知识。为了实现功耗/能量高效的持续学习处理，近年来提出了基于稀疏事件操作的神经形态持续学习（NCL）概念。然而，最先进的NCL方法通常采用内存消耗大的数据/经验回放，并伴随着昂贵的全局学习规则（即基于反向传播的代理梯度）。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了ENCL，这是一种新颖的方法，通过采用轻量级局部学习规则和子网络冻结策略来实现高效的NCL。ENCL利用时间和空间上的局部学习规则为新任务的训练执行高效的信用分配，从而减轻了全局学习规则带来的高昂成本。ENCL还……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出ENCL方法，通过轻量级的时空局部学习规则和子网络冻结策略，取代传统神经形态持续学习中内存消耗大的经验回放和昂贵的全局学习规则，实现了高效的持续学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ENCL, which enables efficient neuromorphic continual learning by replacing memory-hungry experience replay and costly global learning rules with a lightweight temporally- and spatially-local learning rule and a sub-network freezing strategy.
